ai.title: Fruvia Chatbot
ai.desc: Customize privacy, behavior, and productivity controls for Fruvia Chatbot.

full_access.title: Allow AI to access all your data
full_access.desc: Give AI permission to access your full chat, document, and profile data for the most complete responses.

answer_general.title: Answer general questions
answer_general.desc: Allow AI to answer common questions and basic conversational requests.

read_recent_messages.title: Read recent message context
read_recent_messages.desc: Allow AI to use recent chat messages to improve response relevance.

access_my_documents.title: Access My Documents context
access_my_documents.desc: Allow AI to use file and folder metadata when discussing your documents.

use_profile_context.title: Personalize using profile context
use_profile_context.desc: Allow AI to reference your profile details for tailored suggestions.

coding_assistant.title: Coding assistant
coding_assistant.desc: Optimize answers for coding and technical tasks (Java, NoSQL, APIs, debugging).

translation_mode.title: Translation mode
translation_mode.desc: Automatically prioritize translation to your preferred language.

execute_quick_commands.title: Execute AI quick commands
execute_quick_commands.desc: Enable quick actions like summarize, TODO extraction, and helper workflows.

auto_code_formatting.title: Auto code formatting
auto_code_formatting.desc: Render cleaner markdown and code blocks for easier copy/paste.

ai_suggestions.title: AI suggestions
ai_suggestions.desc: Show suggested replies based on current conversation context.

incognito_mode.title: Incognito mode
incognito_mode.desc: AI still replies, but the conversation is not stored in database or vector memory.

redact_sensitive_data.title: Redact sensitive data
redact_sensitive_data.desc: Automatically mask data like passwords or card numbers before AI requests.

data_opt_out.title: Do not use data for training
data_opt_out.desc: Request that your chat content is not used for model training purposes.

auto_delete_history.title: Auto delete history
auto_delete_history.desc: Automatically remove AI history based on your selected retention period.
